title: Abandoned House Part 2: Exterior Makeover 😱
hook: Abandoned house, part 2: the exterior makeover
caption: Part 2 of turning one abandoned house into a luxury home 🏚️➡️✨ From forgotten to beautiful ✨ What would you add to this house?
narration: This house looked completely hopeless. The crew pressure-washed years of grime off the walls, put in a brand new driveway, and added warm outdoor lights. The final result is unbelievable. In part 3, you choose the next room. Follow so you don't miss it. And it all started... right here.
